newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AUSTRIAN ATX FIRMS, EYES RESISTANCE AT 1,485.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRIAN ATX FIRMS, EYES RESISTANCE AT 1,485.

text.p: Austrian shares held onto early gains on Thursday, propelled 1.14 percent higher by strong international sentiment, traders said.
The blue-chip ATX index finished 16.5 points up at 1,465.
Market participants forecast the ATX would continue its rally up above 1,470 points. It faced resistance at 1,485.
"Today's gains were all down to the foreign lead. The current trading range is 1,453-1,473 and I expect to see the ATX at the higher end of that range tomorrow," a dealer said.
"Then it should test, and hopefully overcome, 1,485."
Overall 16 shares were up, three down and two unchanged.
The top gainer was steelmaker VA Stahl, rising 3.78 percent to 618.55 schillings.
Leading decliner were Creditanstalt preferred shares, down 3.07 percent to 600 schillings. Traders said the drop was a reaction to Wednesday's 10 percent jump.
August ATX futures were up 25 points at 1,471.0.
The all-share Vienna bourse index climbed 3.97 points, or 0.76 percent, to 524.29. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
